Hello, this is TeeVee. It lives in this page and learns as you go: stroke it to pet it, tap to poke it, and leave it alone to see what it does. It saves itself in this browser.

Bends the whole picture like a lens. The mind net makes it a little stronger when something surprises it.

The face turns on its own axes (3D, one face only), with the mind net's gaze (degrees).

Face settings

Left: what it senses. Middle: its inner state (its units that keep moving by themselves). Right: what it wants. Lines show the strongest causes.
A small neural network decides how TeeVee looks around, smiles, fidgets or glitches. The bars are what it wants right now; it learns from how you treat it: petting and praise reinforce what it was doing, pokes and scolding discourage it.

Each row is a day, its 24 boxes the hours from midnight.
